# Eren for Business

> Eren helps established small businesses improve their website, their workflow and the software behind them, then builds the agreed change. Based in Rockford, Illinois; works with owners online. Founder: Ben.

How it works: a free 15-minute First Look, then a paid Diagnose ($750) of one problem with up to three ranked improvements, then an optional Build (from $1,500, one fixed price agreed first). Existing software is checked first, and configuring or connecting it is compared with building something new. AI is added only where it fits, and a person approves what it drafts before anything goes out.

## Services
- [Services](https://erenforbusiness.com/services.html): website restructuring, workflow and connected tools, practical AI inside one defined job
- [AI for small business](https://erenforbusiness.com/ai-for-business.html): one defined job, approved sources, a named reviewer
- [Custom software](https://erenforbusiness.com/custom-software.html): configure, connect or build, in that order
- [Pricing](https://erenforbusiness.com/pricing.html): First Look, Diagnose and Build, with FAQs
- [Free First Look](https://erenforbusiness.com/first-look.html)
